name: KOTO detector

technology.value: Hermetic electromagnetic calorimeter and veto-counter system surrounding a neutral-kaon beamline, reconstructing KL -> pi0 (-> gamma gamma) decays while vetoing all other visible particles
technology.note: General description of the KOTO technique; a dedicated detector-paper full text was not fetched this session, only the official experiment site.

intervals.label: operating
intervals.note: See experiment:koto for the run-by-run breakdown.

summary.plain: The KOTO detector is a hermetic calorimeter and veto system in Japan that watches for the tell-tale flash of a neutral kaon decaying into a neutral pion and invisible particles, with nothing else visible.
summary.technical: Hermetic CsI electromagnetic calorimeter with surrounding veto counters at the J-PARC Hadron Experimental Facility, reconstructing KL -> pi0(->gamma gamma) nu nubar candidates against visible-particle vetoes.

notes: Placed at the existing site:j-parc-hadron-hall (owned by the muons workstream, already on file).
